1247710.name: picomatch
1247710.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
1247710.reason: No patched version of picomatch available as of 2026-11-18 — the advisory covers every published version (<=4.0.7), and 2.3.2 and 4.0.7 are already the latest on their release lines. npm's suggested --force fix would downgrade vite from 8 to 6.2.7 without resolving it.
1247710.impact: picomatch is only reached through build and deploy tooling: vite (directly and via tinyglobby/fdir), babel-plugin-styled-components (via styled-components), and gh-pages (globby → fast-glob → micromatch). It matches globs from our own config and file paths in the repo, never user input, and it is not part of the built docs site.
1247710.wayForward: Wait for picomatch to publish a release above 4.0.7 (and a patched 2.x, or for babel-plugin-styled-components and gh-pages to move off picomatch 2), then run npm audit fix and remove this acknowledgement
